subject: Day One planning: proposed calendar blocks, attendee roster, and bridge info
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Khan <alex.khan@sunsethealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 1 Dec 2029 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Day One planning: proposed calendar blocks, attendee roster, and bridge info

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for prioritizing the Day One session. To keep scheduling simple across your team and ours, proposed plan below (all times PST):

• Option A: Tue 2029-12-10, 09:00–11:30 — deep technical onboarding (model config, data paths, network prep)
• Option B: Wed 2029-12-11, 13:00–15:30 — condensed combined session (exec sync + tech)

Suggested agenda (draft):
1) 09:00–09:10 — Welcome & goals (Marissa)
2) 09:10–09:35 — Exec alignment & success metrics (Alex / Sunset lead)
3) 09:35–10:10 — Architecture overview & network checklist (Jonas)
4) 10:10–10:25 — Break
5) 10:25–11:05 — Deployment runbook & access handoffs (Monica)
6) 11:05–11:25 — Next steps, milestones, and owner matrix (Marissa)
7) 11:25–11:30 — Q&A & close

Attendee roster from our side: Marissa Cole (CSM), Jonas Weber (Platform Eng), Monica Patel (Onboarding Lead). Can you confirm who from Sunset should attend each segment (execs vs infra vs procurement)? If Option A or B works for you, I’ll send calendar invites with bridge + attachments.

I attached a one-page Day One agenda and a short bridge access doc we use for customers (stubs below). If procurement needs a separate invite, please loop them in.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: DayOne-Agenda-v1.pdf (1 page) | Bridge-Access-Instructions.txt (stub)
From: Alex Khan <alex.khan@sunsethealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: onboard@sunsethealth.com, procurement@sunsethealth.com
Date: Mon, 2 Dec 2029 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Day One planning: proposed calendar blocks, attendee roster, and bridge info

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear options. Option A (Tue 12/10 morning) is preferable for our infra folks. High-level attendee mapping from Sunset:

• Exec alignment: Alex Khan (me) + Priya Desai (VP Product) — join first 30 min only
• Infra & network: Omar Reyes (Network Lead), Lila Chen (Cloud Ops) — full session
• Procurement: procurement@sunsethealth.com — will join for access and billing discussion (last 20 min)

One ask: please add a 15-minute pre-brief for our infra team on Tue 12/10 at 08:30 PST just to validate access keys and firewall rules. Can you confirm Jonas can do an early 08:30 pre-brief? Also confirm how we’ll deliver the agent credentials (KMS or secure SFTP).

Thanks —
Alex
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Khan <alex.khan@sunsethealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Dec 2029 13:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Day One planning: proposed calendar blocks, attendee roster, and bridge info

Alex / team —

08:30 pre-brief on Tue 12/10 works for me. I’ll be available to validate firewall rules, VPC peering, and KMS access. Quick notes on credentials:

• Preferred: customer-managed KMS key assigned to the service account. We’ll provide a minimal IAM policy for the key.
• Fallback: short-lived SFTP bundle with one-time password (we automate rotation).

Monica — I’m adding Priyom to keep track of the rollout checklist (inventory of service accounts, secrets, and CI/CD hooks). Priyom, can you prep the onboarding checklist and the bridge dial-in (Zoom with recorded consent) so we can include the join link in the final invite?

Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Khan <alex.khan@sunsethealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 5 Dec 2029 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Day One planning: proposed calendar blocks, attendee roster, and bridge info

Alex —

Great — I’ve locked Option A and added the 08:30 pre-brief. Calendar invites and one consolidated Day One invite will go out to the full roster. Summary / next steps:

1) Tue 2029-12-10 08:30–08:45 PST — Infra pre-brief (Jonas, Omar, Lila)
2) Tue 2029-12-10 09:00–11:30 PST — Day One onboarding (full roster)

Attachments sent with invites: DayOne-Agenda-v1.pdf, Bridge-Access-Instructions.txt
Bridge: Zoom (join link included in invites)
Credentials delivery: Alex, please confirm whether Sunset will provide a customer-managed KMS key or if you prefer SFTP bundle. If KMS, we’ll send the minimal IAM policy and a short verification checklist before the pre-brief.

Action items:
• Alex: confirm KMS vs SFTP (reply to thread)
• Priyom: attach onboarding checklist and Zoom join link in invites (in progress)
• Monica: own access handoffs during the main session

If no objections, I’ll send invites in the next hour.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
